newTest.name: TestDockerLiveNPMBuildWorkerAndPythonSpawnSQLite
newTest.optIn: GEMMA_TEST_DOCKER_IMAGE must be an installed immutable image digest; live execution remains gated on root explicit campaign completion and permission.
newTest.node: Actual real-executor request runs npm run build with offline/no-audit/no-fund/update-notifier-disabled flags. The package build script asserts npm_lifecycle_event=build, invokes installed tsc to compile two local TypeScript modules into private tmp, runs a worker_threads Worker from compiled output, asserts value42 and positive worker thread ID, then observes the same result via a temporary guest-only127.0.0.1 HTTP server/client. No dependency installation or network access.
newTest.python: Actual real-executor request runs a guarded Python file using multiprocessing.get_context(spawn). Two child processes write different rows into the same private WAL SQLite database and return distinct PIDs/start-method receipts. Both children must join exit0. A fresh subprocess reopens the database and asserts exact ordered rows and integrity_check=ok. Children are terminated/killed and joined on failure.
newTest.authorityAndResources: Independent embedded test programs only, no candidate/fixture solution reused. Each Request has ReadOnly:true,90-second command timeout,2-minute outer timeout and16KiB bounded output. Production Docker executor supplies4CPUs/8GiB/256PIDs/networknone/read-only root and source snapshot/private tmp. Before/after original source manifest must match; process receipt must report read_only,exit0,no cancellation/truncation; no owner-labelled guest may remain.
newTest.cleanup: Synchronous Run must unwind before recovery. Fresh bounded cleanup reconciles owned guests/journals, explicitly releases the disposable workspace cache and removes the private fixture root only after success. Failure retains/logs recovery state; ordinary project caches and campaign state are untouched.

go.command: env -u GEMMA_TEST_DOCKER_IMAGE GOPATH="$PWD/.cache/go" GOCACHE="$PWD/.cache/gobuild" GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.10 go test -race -json ./internal/execution -run ^TestDockerLiveNPMBuildWorkerAndPythonSpawnSQLite$ -count=1

After explicit campaign-completed authorization, run the exact opt-in test once with the pinned campaign image and retain complete log/exit/source identity as separate live evidence. Do not relabel this compile/skip as a pass.
